title: Uncloud 2026: 10 Years of Breaking the Binary
excerpt: The tenth year of Uncloud. Co-curated, with work shown and performed, the exhibition's control system built and the technical production run.
description:
Uncloud's tenth year, 1 to 11 October 2026, at the Beatrixgebouw in Utrecht, presented with Modulation.
I co-curated the edition, showed work in it and performed live. I also built the main control system for the exhibition and ran the technical production, including arranging the sponsors.
credits: Co-curation, exhibition control system, technical production and sponsors: Jaco Schilp. Work shown and live performance: Jaco Schilp. A project by Uncloud, with Modulation.
